steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's finally over.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: The ring... is it really gone?
You nod, speaking in a cheerful tone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes, and now it's your turn—the complete you—to take control of your own destiny and future.

Fallen stone pillars lay silently strewn across the hall, walls adorned with sprawling cracks, shattered glass scattered on the floor. Blood-stained silk sways gently in the breeze before settling back into the profound stillness.
On the horizon, clouds glow with the first faint light of dawn. The night at Morveth Castle is coming to an end.

steps.speaker: No. 15
steps.content: Thank goodness! You're alright, Graves!
No. 15 races toward you both, wrapping Graves in a tight embrace, her eyes brimming with tears.
Nearby, Dullahan clears his throat as if trying to hide his emotions, but the dancing flame betrays his true feelings.

steps.speaker: Dullahan
steps.content: Well, I never would have thought we'd finally witness a wedding miracle.
Luminita saunters over at her own leisurely pace, her agent instincts in full swing as she surveys the surroundings, wincing slightly at the extent of the damage.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: This place is a total wreck, not a single floorboard spared... Well, at least the crisis is all sorted out. Renovations can always be done later...

You look up at Graves. The contamination hasn't fully receded from her body—crimson patterns still intertwine with her normal skin. Yet she makes no attempt to hide it, nor does she avoid your gaze. She simply stands there in silence, visibly flustered about what to do now that she sees the castle in ruins.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's all that damn ring's fault. Once we get back to the Bureau, I'll ask you more about it...

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Hold your horses!
Before you can finish your sentence, Luminita cuts you off.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...What's the matter?

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: I get that you're excited to take your bride home, but hang tight just a moment.
Faced with four puzzled stares converging on her, Luminita responds with a sly wink. She presses her palms together and flashes you an ingratiating smile.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Before you dash off, would you be so kind as to do me one tiny little favor, oh esteemed Chief?

Several days later, sunlight streams through the castle's stained glass windows into the hall, casting warm, kaleidoscopic patterns across the interior. The Mania storm that once raged here has faded into history, and the castle now embraces a new chapter—

The debris and rubble have been cleared away, though the chandeliers remain damaged, the floors uneven, and cracks in the walls only partially repaired. Yet these imperfections now add a distinctive charm to the place.
Luminita, dressed in formal business attire with a speaker clipped to her waist, stands surrounded by tourists as she delivers her presentation with boundless enthusiasm:

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Welcome to Morveth Castle, the premier wedding destination! This place not only carries a century of matrimonial history, but also conceals... mysterious legends of marriages with the departed!
A ripple of gasps spreads through the crowd—exactly the reaction Luminita was hoping for. She nods with satisfaction and continues in a deliberately hushed, mysterious tone.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: It was in this very hall that brides and grooms pledged their vows of eternal fidelity. Yet, their stories often lacked proper endings... Perhaps some love stories don't end in the realm of the living, but continue beyond the grave.
A young girl curiously raises her hand.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: I read online that if you make a wish here, you can see your deceased lover and reconnect with them. Is that true?

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Of course!
Luminita puts on her professional smile.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: True love can break all rules and the boundary between life and death. As long as your bond lingers unresolved, the castle holds the key to closure...
After sharing a few more stories and going over some guidelines, Luminita glances at the watch on her wrist and claps her hands.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Alright everyone! It's now free exploration time. Feel free to look around the hall, then meet back here with me in 20 minutes for our next activity!
The tourists disperse throughout the hall, filling the space with a chorus of conversations, laughter, and the clicking of camera shutters.
Two daring young men are teasing each other in front of a deteriorating mural.

steps.speaker: Young Man A
steps.content: Hey, you're always going on about how brave you are. So what do you say, dare to stay the night here?

steps.speaker: Young Man B
steps.content: Why sweat it? You wanna make a bet?

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Ahem, excuse me.
Luminita steps into the conversation at just the right moment.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Just a friendly reminder: Your tickets are for the half-day tour only, so unfortunately, extended stays aren't included. If you're keen on an overnight experience, that's an additional fee—though I could throw in a little discount for you both...
Just as Luminita is busy pitching them discounted packages, a little boy approaches and timidly tugs at the hem of her coat.

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: Miss Tour Guide, are there monsters in here?

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Monsters? Hehe, perhaps. They might even be right behind us as we speak. And by the way, I'm a real estate agent, not a tour guide, little one!

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: Ah...
The visibly frightened boy flinches, but Luminita gently pats his head with a reassuring smile.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: But hey, no need to be spooked! Who says monsters always have to be scary villains? You know what? Some monsters even stumble over their words while rehearsing wedding speeches.
As she speaks, she casts a smiling glance toward a corner of the hall.

In the shadows beyond the visitors' sight, No. 15 cautiously peers out, her gaze fixed on a figure in the crowd who seems both familiar and strange—the boy who once visited the castle to make wishes, now fully grown into a man. He stands quietly at the back of the group, appearing to search for something.
No. 15 hesitates for a moment, but ultimately summons the courage to step forward.

steps.speaker: No. 15
steps.content: ...You're here.
The man whips around, his eyes instantly lighting up.

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: You... you're really still here!

steps.speaker: No. 15
steps.content: Stop coming here to make wishes! Every time you describe me differently—just look what I've become!

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: If I stop making wishes, I'm worried you might vanish without their power keeping you here!

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: I was so young when we first met. I honestly can't remember what you originally looked like...

steps.speaker: No. 15
steps.content: ...I like how I am now. Just remember me as I am today.

They gaze at each other with the most sincere and tender looks. There's still so much left unsaid between them—misunderstandings to resolve, years of longing to express, and countless other things to share.
Meanwhile, Dullahan stands silently in the shadows, his gaze fixed on a mother and son.
They stand at the opposite end of the hall—the energetic little boy bouncing ahead while the young woman holds his hand, her gentle, loving gaze never leaving her child.

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: Mom, don't be scared! If any monsters or ghosts really show up, I'll chase them all away! I'm a real man now, and from now on, I'll be the one protecting you!

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: Haha, my little hero is so brave.

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: Hehe, soon I'll be just as awesome as Dad!

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: Dad will be proud of me, right?
Dullahan doesn't approach to disturb them, murmuring softly to himself.

steps.speaker: Dullahan
steps.content: Of course. You have always been my pride, both of you.
Even when separated by life and death, divided between the realms of light and shadow, their stories are never forgotten—they live on eternally in the memories of those who love them.
From another corner of the hall, you and Graves hide in the shadows, silently watching everything unfold.

Graves meticulously adjusts the hem of her dress, yet her curious eyes can't help but dart occasionally toward the bustling scene outside. You notice her unease. Morveth Castle hasn't been this lively in ages, that much is certain.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't worry, they're just tourists here for sightseeing. The Bureau has evaluated the M-value and Mania entities in this area and determined they won't be affected.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Sightseeing?
You nod and begin to explain patiently.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The area around Morveth Castle has been deserted for years, and I doubt anyone will visit this place for a while. Luminita suggested turning it into a paranormal romance-themed tourist spot, but that's really not very practical.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But... if this attraction opens just once, giving closure to some unfulfilled wishes, I suppose there's no harm in letting our agent friend earn some ticket money this one time.
Graves nods, her expression still tinged with a hint of confusion and reluctance.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Alright... but I still think Sister Elsie would be a little disappointed if people stopped coming here to get married.
You can't help but smile at her grimace.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Relax, everything takes time and happens step by step. At least right now your wedding sanctuary is bustling with life again, isn't it?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As for what comes after, we can figure that out later—how to revitalize the nearby satellite town, how to manage the lingering creatures in the castle—we can take our time planning it all. After all, there's plenty of time ahead for us.

There's plenty of time ahead—truly a phrase brimming with hope and vitality. It implies endless possibilities and opportunities for change, promising a brighter tomorrow, one always worth looking forward to and chasing after.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Yeah, there's plenty of time ahead for us.
This time, Graves embraces the idea with remarkable ease. Her smile is unburdened, her expression more radiant and vibrant than you have ever seen before.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Time's up, everyone! Please gather around now. We're about to move on to the next part of our tour!

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: As the very first visitors to Morveth Castle, we've prepared something extra special for you—
Amidst Luminita's announcement and the murmuring of guests, you and Graves, both formally dressed for the occasion, walk hand-in-hand into the center of the hall.
Luminita clears her throat and continues with a smile.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Today, we gather to witness the first covenant being forged in the newly restored Morveth Castle.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: However, please note that this is not your typical wedding ceremony, but a covenant founded on freedom, understanding, respect, and coexistence.
The visitors fall silent, all eyes fixed on you both, curious or expectant.

In a corner not far away, No. 15, Dullahan, and the castle's other monsters huddle against the wall. They have promised the Bureau not to disturb the visitors, so they can only crane their necks, watching from afar as the little girl who has kept them company every night takes step after step forward.
The once-lonely "little monster" has finally found someone worthy of her trust and a place where she truly belongs.
You stand firmly in the center of the hall and raise the champagne bottle.
It endures the darkness of night and absorbs the sunlight.
Bang!!
Everyone in the hall turns toward the source of the sound—

In full view of everyone, one of the monsters guiltily tries to hide half of a candelabra base behind its back. However, the pieces and metal fragments still falling from the wall beside it completely betray its "crime."

Most likely, it was watching the ceremony with such nervous excitement that it unconsciously gripped a "handle" too forcefully, accidentally wrenching the wall-mounted decorative candelabra right off.
A mass of glowing eyes in the darkness face the visitors frozen in shock. The two groups stare at each other, unanimously sinking into an eerie silence.
The monsters finally snap out of their daze, frantically scrambling to retreat into the darkness or vanish from sight, but it is clearly too late...

steps.speaker: Young Man A
steps.content: Ghosts! Aaaahhhh—

steps.speaker: Young Man B
steps.content: Spiders! So many of them... and they're huge... Aaaahhhh—

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Aaarrrgh! That statue is moving! It's walking toward us!

steps.speaker: Young Man A
steps.content: Run! Run!! The monsters are coming to eat us! Ahhhhh!!!
The crowd erupts in chaos, unleashing a massive wave of screams and cries so deafening it seems the castle roof might blow off at any moment.
Amid the chaotic stampede, a flustered Luminita darts back and forth, grabbing one visitor and blocking another, her shoes practically striking sparks against the floor.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Everyone, please calm down! Don't rush off! Our tour isn't over yet!

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: I swear on my professional reputation that these are just special effects! You have to believe me—
But under these circumstances, such a forced explanation appears utterly unconvincing. Not a single visitor buys it, all of them shaking off her hands as they continue screaming and fleeing in panic.
You're about to direct the nearby guards to handle this chaos when, as if perfectly timed to make matters worse, your terminal starts ringing urgently in your pocket.
The moment you answer, a cacophony of overlapping voices immediately floods from the speaker.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, I heard you went to get married. What is that? Is it dangerous?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Seriously?! You got married without inviting us? That's outrageous!

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Master, Labyrinth anticipates partaking in your marry-making. Powerfrugal Maid III does not require sustenance.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wait, this is a misunderstanding...
In the midst of your flustered attempt to explain, your eyes instinctively dart toward Graves, who stands beside you.
She stands there with her head lowered, shoulders slightly trembling, lips pressed tightly together.
She's trying hard not to laugh.

Chaos still reigns all around—tourists cowering fearfully in corners, monsters clumsily cleaning up their "evidence," and the barrage of questions still coming through your terminal—but in this moment, she seems to exist in her own dimension of serenity separate from the whole world.

In the distance, sunlight streams through the broken stained glass windows into the hall, falling upon Graves's gently shaking shoulders, as well as the weathered pews, tarnished candelabras, and dust-covered stone tiles, tracing their irregular outlines as if in a dream.
From a crack in the wall, a small, unidentified flower has pushed through unexpectedly, swaying gently in the light.
You see Graves lift her face slightly.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Perhaps, this really is a good story.
A window, sealed shut for many years, is quietly opened to welcome the first gentle spring breeze after countless lonely seasons.
[ED]
(Scene change)

Somewhere far away, a woman gazes toward Morveth Castle with keen interest. She raises her hand, observing as a wound slowly forms on her ring finger, circling all the way around. Blood seeps out and trickles down along her veins.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Woman
steps.content: ...I would've been fine with it not returned, but why did you have to destroy it? It's not like I lost the ring on purpose.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Woman
steps.content: I'll find you later for compensation.
With a slight pressure from her fingertips, her blood congeals and changes color, transforming into a new ring. The woman chuckles softly before turning and vanishing into the shadows.
(Scene change)
The lights in the Chief's office remain bright, with several investigation reports on Morveth Castle spread across the spacious desk.

What can be confirmed thus far is that Graves has no knowledge of the picture book's or the ring's origins. She simply obtained the ring by chance, which offered the promise of a lover. As for why you were chosen to be her "true love," the latest investigation report hints at a direction:
Within the strangely fragrant ashes of the picture book, you have found a trace of <color=#fb9259>the Underground sorcery</color>.
You gently close the report.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I will find you.
